info.title: graph-cli
info.description: A .NET global tool for interacting with Microsoft Graph — manage emails, calendar events, Teams chats, To Do tasks, presence, user directory, OneDrive/SharePoint files, and SharePoint site pages from the command line.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Microsoft Graph CLI - manage mail, calendar, chat, tasks, and more

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: json or table [default: json]

options.name: --timezone
options.description: Timezone for datetime input/output (IANA e.g. 'Asia/Karachi' or Windows e.g. 'Pakistan Standard Time'). Defaults to local system timezone.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Account profile to use for this invocation. Overrides GRAPH_CLI_PROFILE; defaults to 'default'. Bind one profile per MCP server instead of switching state.

commands.name: search
commands.description: Search chats by topic or member (cache-backed). On miss the most recent chats are pulled via paginated API call with members expanded.

options.name: --query
options.description: Search text (case-insensitive match against chat topic, member display name, or member email)

options.name: --refresh
options.description: Skip cache, force a fresh paginated API fetch (up to --max-depth) and merge into cache [default: False]

options.name: --max-depth
options.description: Maximum number of chats to pull from the API when refreshing or on cache miss (ordered by most recently active) [default: 200]

commands.name: find-with
commands.description: Find chats whose members include a specific user (server-side filter)

options.name: --user
options.description: User email, UPN, or AAD object ID

options.name: --type
options.description: Chat type filter: oneOnOne, group, or all [default: all]

options.name: --type
options.description: Chat type: oneOnOne or group [default: oneOnOne]

commands.name: since
commands.description: Fetch all new chat messages across every Teams chat since a given time. Cache-backed watermark supports incremental polling for automation (store to SQLite/JSON, extract tasks, etc.).

options.name: --since
options.description: Cutoff: ISO 8601 (2026-07-15T13:00), a time ('1pm'), 'today'/'yesterday', or a relative offset ('-3h', '-2d', '-1w'). Not required with --continue.

options.name: --continue
options.description: Resume from the watermark saved by the previous run (ignores --since) [default: False]

options.name: --exclude-own
options.description: Drop messages you sent yourself [default: False]

options.name: --no-save-watermark
options.description: Do not persist a new watermark (leaves --continue cursor unchanged) [default: False]

options.name: --content-type
options.description: Content type: text or html [default: text]

options.name: --mentions
options.description: Comma-separated user emails or AAD IDs to @-mention (requires --content-type html; body must contain <at id="N">Name</at> tags)
